Ekegusii: Ekaba Alekisanda o Makedonia, omwana o Filipo, ere nigo aruete ase ense ya Kitimu. Akamogwera na komobua Dario omorwoti o Persia na Media na koba omorwoti ribaga riaye. Ase ebiro ebio Alekisanda konye obeire omorwoti bwa Abagiriki.

English: He fought many battles, won many strongholds, killed the kings of the earth,
Ekegusii: Ere akarwana chiseegi chinyinge, akayeira emechie yagitire na kobaita abarwoti b’echinse echio.

English: went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of a multitude of nations. The earth was quiet before him. He was exalted. His heart was lifted up.
Ekegusii: Alekisanda agasuka motwe goika chinsinyo chi’ense, akabiira ebisaku bitakobareka. Omoerio, ekero ense engima yatoererete inse yoborai bwaye, akerora kegima na kweigwa koba omonene.

English: He gathered together an exceedingly strong army and ruled over countries, nations, and principalities, and they paid him tribute.
Ekegusii: Akaroisia abarwani bare ne chinguru chieetanetie, akagaambera ense, ebisaku na abanene baabo; akababetereria komorwera ebango.

English: After these things he fell sick, and perceived that he was going to die.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Alekisanda akarwara akaigwa buna oikire ang’e nogokwa.

English: He called his honorable servants, which had been brought up with him from his youth, and he divided to them his kingdom while he was still alive.
Ekegusii: Ere akabarangeria abanene baye bengeencho abwo barenge bagisangio baye abwo bakiinete nere korwa obwana na kobagabera oborwoti bwaye kare moyo.

English: Alexander reigned twelve years, then he died.
Ekegusii: Ekero akwete, Alekisanda konye ogaambire ase emiaka ikomi ne ebere.

English: Then his servants ruled, each one in his place.
Ekegusii: Abanene baye bagachaaka kogaamba kera oyomo ase orogongo rwaye.

English: They all put crowns upon themselves after he was dead, and so did their sons after them many years; and they multiplied evils on the earth.
Ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bakabekerwa chigutwa chi’oborwoti ekero Alekisanda akwete na ababiare baabo bakaba abarwoti nyuma yaabo ase emiaka emenge; na barabwo bakarenta amabe amange mono ase ense engima.

English: There came out of them a sinful root, Antiochus Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been a hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the one hundred thirty seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
Ekegusii: Oyomo ase ababiare abwo nere oria omotwambu, Antioko Epifane mosinto bwa Antioko. Ekero konye atarabekerwa eguutwa yoborwoti ase omwaka o 137 ase ebiro bia Abagiriki, ere Antioko Epifane nigo arenge omooswa ase ense ya Rumi.

English: In those days transgressors of the law came out of Israel and persuaded many, saying, “Let’s go make a covenant with the Gentiles around us; for since we were separated from them many evils have befallen us.”
Ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio gekaimoka ekeombe kia Abayahudi batasigete richiiko ase ense ya Israeli ekio giasaretie abanto abange kegoteeba: “Tiga togende toroisie okobwatana ne chinse chitobebekaine ekiagera korwa tweatananete na barabwo twanyorire amabe amange.”

English: That proposal was good in their eyes.
Ekegusii: Okogania okwo gokagookia abanto,

English: Some of the people eagerly went to the king, and he authorized them to observe the ordinances of the Gentiles.
Ekegusii: na ase egati yabo bakamochiera omorwoti nekeririanda. Omorwoti akabanchera gotunyana chingeencho na amenario ye ebisaku binde.

English: So they built a gymnasium in Jerusalem according to the laws of the Gentiles.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaagacha egetii giechigosori ime yomochie o Yerusalemu ase omogwekano bwe ebisaku binde.

English: They made themselves uncircumcised, forsook the holy covenant, joined themselves to the Gentiles, and sold themselves to do evil.
Ekegusii: Bakarusia ebimanyererio biokwaroka ase emebere yaabo na gotiga okobwatana ogochenu. Bakabwatana amo na abanto bebisaku binde bakenyinyeka ase ogokora amabe.

English: The kingdom was established in the sight of Antiochus, and he planned to reign over Egypt, that he might reign over both kingdoms.
Ekegusii: Ekero arooche oborwoti bwaye bwatenenire, Antioko akarengereria koyeira Misiri erio abe omorwoti bw’ense eyio amo na Siria.

English: He entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, with elephants, with cavalry, and with a great navy.
Ekegusii: Erio akayegwera Misiri ore n’obonge bwa abarwani baye abatindi be chibaarasi amo nechinchogu boigo ebirwanero bia amaache ye chinyancha.

English: He made war against Ptolemy king of Egypt. Ptolemy was put to shame before him, and fled; and many fell wounded to death.
Ekegusii: Ekero esegi yachia gete, Tolemai, omorwoti o Misiri akeringa gochia magega erio agatama. Abarwani baye abange bagaitwa.

English: They took possession of the strong cities in the land of Egypt, and he took the spoils of Egypt.
Ekegusii: Erio Antioko akanyara koyeira ense yonsi n’emechie yagiteire chinyasi ekabwatwa n’ense ya Misiri.

English: Antiochus, after he had defeated Egypt, returned in the one hundred forty third year, and went up against Israel and Jerusalem with a great multitude,
Ekegusii: Magega yokoira Misiri, Antioko amo na abarwani baye abatindi bakayecheira ense ya Israeli, Omwaka o 143, agaika ase omochie o Yerusalemu.

English: and entered presumptuously into the sanctuary, and took the golden altar, the lampstand for the light, and all its utensils.
Ekegusii: Ase oboenenu agasoa ime ye Hekalu na koira ekebekerero gietaabu kiebing’wanso korwa igoro y’egesaasimero boigo ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo ne ebinto binde bionsi.

English: He took the table of the show bread, the cups for the drink offerings, the bowls, the golden censers, the veil, the crowns, and the gold decoration on the front of the temple. He peeled it all off.
Ekegusii: Boigo akayeimokia emesa yemegati yabeekire ase obosio b’Omonene, ebitaabo ebichenu, chibaakuli, ebiutero bi’etaabu, ebitambaa ne chiguutwa. Agataagora ebichabero bi’etaabu biarenge ase enyasi ya motwe ye Hekalu.

English: He took the silver, the gold, and the precious vessels. He took the hidden treasures which he found.
Ekegusii: Akabiira ebibekerero bi’etaabu na efeta na ebinto bionsi bie erigori, kobekerania ebinto bionsi bie erigori anyoorete bibisire aroro.

English: When he had taken all of these, he went away into his own land. He made a great slaughter, and spoke very arrogantly.
Ekegusii: Akabibogoria bionsi erio akabiira goika ense yaye. Ere konye oiteire amanyinga amaange mono na akaba ogwetogeria ring’ana erio.

English: Great mourning came upon Israel, in every place where they were.
Ekegusii: Agatiga ekerero ekenene ase ense yonsi ya Israeli.

English: The rulers and elders groaned. The virgins and young men were made feeble. The beauty of the women was changed.
Ekegusii: Abagaambi amo na abagaaka bakarera nokweumia okonene, abamura na abaiseke bakagoya ne ekieni kia abakungu baito gekarachoka.

English: Every bridegroom took up lamentation. She who sat in the marriage chamber was mourning.
Ekegusii: Kera omonyanyangi akeumia nogotera kw’amagombo; kera omoriakari akereera ime ase enyomba yaye.

English: The land was moved for its inhabitants, and all the house of Jacob was clothed with shame.
Ekegusii: Abanto baito bonsi bagekuuneka nobosooku, ense yaito yonsi egatengechigwa.

English: After two full years, the king sent a chief collector of tribute to the cities of Judah, and he came to Jerusalem with a great multitude.
Ekegusii: Magega ye emiaka ebere, omorwoti Antioko agatoma abarwani abange b’esegi korwa Misia mamincha yemechie ya Yudea. Ekero abarwani abwo baigete Yerusalemu,

English: He spoke words of peace to them in subtlety, and they believed him. Then he fell upon the city suddenly, struck it very severely, and destroyed many people of Israel.
Ekegusii: Ase obong’ainereria omonene bwa abarwani abwo agakwana amang’ana amaansu y’omorembe korende ase okobatega. Erio kegima, akayosaagana mobasokano omochie oria na koyosaria bobe mono. Agaita omoganda bwa abanto abange.

English: He took the spoils of the city, set it on fire, and pulled down its houses and its walls on every side.
Ekegusii: Akayosamba omorero na koyaira omochie o Yerusalemu, agatagora chinyomba ne chinyasi chinsemo chionsi,

English: They led captive the women and the children, and seized the livestock.
Ekegusii: akaaosa abakungu, abana ne chitugo.

English: Then they fortified the city of David with a large, strong wall and with strong towers, and it became their citadel.
Ekegusii: Erio Antioko amo na abarwani baye bakaagacha omorobiri omotambe omokong’u goetanana Omochie o Daudi; bakabeka ekambi yaabo aroro agwo.

English: They put a sinful nation, transgressors of the law, there, and they strengthened themselves in it.
Ekegusii: Akababeeka abanto batasigete richiiko koba abareendi agwo. Barabwo bagakong’ia oborendi bwabo;

English: They stored up weapons and food, and gathering together the spoils of Jerusalem, they stored them there, and they became a great menace.
Ekegusii: bagasangereria na kwegachera chindagera amo ne ebirwanero, bagasangereria ebisakore bionsi barusetie Yerusalemu, bakabibeka ase ekambi ime. Ekambi eyio ekaba okoirokia okonene ase omochi o Yerusalemu.

English: It became a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Israel continually.
Ekegusii: Nigo yarenge okoirokia ase Hekalu, na omochando otakoera ase Israeli.

English: They shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled the sanctuary.
Ekegusii: Abanto batari na komocha bagaiterwa ase chinsinyo chie egesasiimero; ase igo, aase achenu akabekwa ogotacheneka.

English: The inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them. She became a habitation of foreigners. She became foreign to those who were born in her, and her children forsook her.
Ekegusii: Abamenyi ba Yerusalemu bagatama ase engencho yaabo, na omochie oyio okaba oyo bwa abamenyi na okaba omogeni ase abanyene omochie boigo abana bakayotiga.

English: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her Sabbaths into reproach, and her honor into contempt.
Ekegusii: Hekalu yaye egatigara ekamogete buna erooro; amatuko aye amanene akaonchoka koba ay’ebirero, omogooko bw’esabato okaonchoka koba okwangana na esiko yaye ekaba obosooku.

English: According to her glory, so was her dishonor multiplied, and her exaltation was turned into mourning.
Ekegusii: Enyaro yokogwa kwaye ekareng’ana obonene bwaye bw’omochaakano; na ogwetogia kwaye gokaonchoka koba ekerero.

English: King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom that all should be one people,
Ekegusii: Omoerio omorwoti Antioko akariika ogochika ase abanto bonsi ase oborwoti bwaye babe egesaku ekemo,

English: and that each should forsake his own laws. All the nations agreed according to the word of the king.
Ekegusii: naigo kera omonto atugute amenario ne chingeencho chiaye.

English: Many of Israel consented to his worship, sacrificed to the idols, and profaned the Sabbath.
Ekegusii: Abanto be ebisaku binde bionsi bakayanyoora amang’ana ayio yomorwoti. Abange nonya na ase egati ya Abaisraeli bagatunyana edini yaye ase omogooko; bagakora ebing’wanso ase emegwekano b’echinyasae na gosaria esabato.

English: The king sent letters by the hand of messengers to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, that they should follow laws strange to the land,
Ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma abanto kobogoria amarube goika Yerusalemu na Yudea nogochika buna abanto bonsi batunyane amenario nechinchera echio chiabageni.

English: and should forbid whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and drink offerings in the sanctuary; and should profane the Sabbaths and feasts,
Ekegusii: Akabakania tibabaisa korwa ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, chinyeke gose ebiebinyuugwa ime ye Hekalu. Agachiika esabato na’matuko yomochengo agwekane amatuko ande a botaambe.

English: and pollute the sanctuary and those who were holy;
Ekegusii: Abanto bagachiikwa gokora ogotacheneka ase Hekalu na abakoreri baye.

English: that they should build altars, and temples, and shrines for idols, and should sacrifice swine’s flesh and unclean animals;
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo baagachere emegwekano ye chinyasae ebisasimero, bie Hekalu na ase achenu ase okobiruera esadaka ye chimbeche amo ne ching’iti chitachenegeti,

English: and that they should leave their sons uncircumcised, that they should make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation;
Ekegusii: boigo batige tibabaarokia abana baabo. Bakaganerigwa koba abatachenegeti ase chinchera chionsi,

English: so that they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.
Ekegusii: erio banyaare kweba amachiiko na koonchora amenaria ne chingeencho chiabo chionsi.

English: Whoever doesn’t do according to the word of the king, he shall die.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi orenge koamererania nogochika kwomorwoti akanacherwa ogokwa.

English: He wrote according to all these words to his whole kingdom. He appointed overseers over all the people, and he commanded the cities of Judah to sacrifice, city by city.
Ekegusii: Goetania nokoraria ogochika okwo ase ense yonsi omorwoti arenge kogaambera, Antioko akabachoora abateneneri bare gotunyana ogoikeranigwa kwerichiiko erio riaye na kobachiika abanto bonsi b’emechie yonsi ya Yudea baruere chinyasae echio ebing’wanso.

English: From the people were gathered together to them many, everyone who had forsaken the law; and they did evil things in the land.
Ekegusii: Abange ase Abayahudi baria batigete amachiiko, bakabagwera abateneneri abwo. Igo bakarentera ense ogotacheneka ase ogokora obobe obwo,

English: They made Israel to hide themselves in every place of refuge which they had.
Ekegusii: na gokora baria abeegeni barenge ime ya Israeli gotama na kwebisa aa na aria ase barenge konyaara.

English: On the fifteenth day of Chislev, in the one hundred forty fifth year, they built an abomination of desolation upon the altar, and in the cities of Judah on every side they built idol altars.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano omotienyi o Kisilevu, omwaka o 145, omorwoti Antioko agatenenia Okogechia Kwogosaria igoro ase egesasiimero ekenene ase ebing’wanso biogosamberwa biarenge korwerwa ime ye Hekalu na obosasiimero bwe chinyasae bokaagachwa ase kera omochie o Yudea.

English: At the doors of the houses and in the streets they burned incense.
Ekegusii: Erio bakaba bagoutera ubani ase kera enchera ne egesieri kienyomba.

English: They tore the books of the law which they found in pieces and set them on fire.
Ekegusii: Bakabichwera-chweria na gosaamba ebitabu binde bionsi barenge konyoora biriikire amachiiko.

English: Anyone who was found with any a book of the covenant, and if any consented to the law, the king’s sentence delivered him to death.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kwomorwoti, onde bwensi orenge konyoorwa negetabu giokobwatana gose gotunyana amachiiko agaitwa.

English: Thus did they in their might to Israel, to those who were found month by month in the cities.
Ekegusii: Ase kera omotienyi, abanto abwo abatwambu bakaba bagokorera egekuba ase Abaisraeli abwo babwatetwe ase emechie ao ao.

English: On the twenty-fifth day of the month they sacrificed upon the idol altar that was on top of the altar of burnt offering.
Ekegusii: Ekero riaika rituko riemerongo ebere na gatano riomotienyi oyio oyio, abanto abwo bakaruera ekengwanso kiabo kiogosaambwa ase chinyasae chiabo igoro ase egesasiimero ekenene ase ebing’wanso biogosamberwa biarenge korwerwa ime ye Hekalu enchenu.

English: They put to death women who had circumcised their children, according to the commandment.
Ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’omorwoti, bakabaita abakungu bonsi abwo baancherete abana baabo kwaroka,

English: They hung their babies around their necks, and their houses, and those who had circumcised them.
Ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chiabo, baria babaarogetie abana abwo na boigo goita abana abwo bonsi ase okobasung’unanania igoro ase ebigoti bia abaang’ina.

English: Many in Israel were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat unclean things.
Ekegusii: Nonya nabo, Abaisraeli abaange bagatenena ase richiiko na goetia ase okwerwa tibaria chindagera chitachenegeti.

English: They chose to die, that they might not be defiled with the food, and that they might not profane the holy covenant; and they died.
Ekegusii: Bagaetia buna mbuya gokwa kobua gosaria okobwatana ogochenu ase okoria ebitachenegeti na igo, ekeene, abange bagaitwa.

English: Exceedingly great wrath came upon Israel.
Ekegusii: Ase endamwamu ya Nyasae Abaisraeli bagachandeka mono.

English: In those days Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem rose up; and he lived at Modin.
Ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio Matathia mosinto o Yohana na omoochokoro o Simioni Omokuani bw’ororeria rwa Yoaribu, akarua Yerusalemu akageenda komenya Modeini.

English: And he had five sons: John, who was surnamed Gaddis;
Ekegusii: Ere narenge na abana abamura batano: Yohana oyio orenge korokwa Gadi,

English: Simon, who was called Thassi;
Ekegusii: Simioni oyio nainde okorokwa Tasi. Simioni oyio oreenge korokwa Thasi,

English: Judas, who was called Maccabaeus;
Ekegusii: Yuda oyio korokwa Makabi,

English: Eleazar, who was called Avaran; and Jonathan, who was called Apphus.
Ekegusii: Eleazari oyio oreenge korokwa Avarani, na Yonathani oyio oreenge korokwa Afusi.

English: He saw the blasphemies that were committed in Judah and in Jerusalem,
Ekegusii: Ekero Matathia arooche obokaayayu bwakoregete Yudea na Yerusalemu,

English: and he said, “Woe is me! Why was I born to see the destruction of my people and the destruction of the holy city, and to dwell there when it was given into the hand of the enemy, the sanctuary into the hand of foreigners?
Ekegusii: akarera ogoteeba: “Aye bwandire iga! ’Ninki naiboreretwe goika indore obobe obo bwonsi, abanto baane bagosarigwa, ogosarigwa kwomochie omochenu? Imbe inche bweka aiga ndigereretie bosa igo, ase omochie omochenu okobeekwa ase amaboko ya ababisa ne Hekalu enchenu egotigerwa abamenyi?

English: Her temple has become like a man who was glorious.
Ekegusii: Hekalu yabeire buna omonto otari ne esiko;

English: Her vessels of glory are carried away into captivity. Her infants are slain in her streets. Her young men are slain with the enemy’s sword.
Ekegusii: Ebibekerero biaye bie erigori biasakoirwe na gosombwa. Abana baye ebing’werere baiteirwe ase chinchera, abasae baye banyenyirwe n’omoro bwa ababisa.

English: What nation has not inherited her palaces and taken possession of her spoils?
Ekegusii: Kera egesaku giense kiamenyete ime y’omochie oito na gosakora chinibo chiaito!

English: Her adornment has all been taken away. Instead of a free woman, she has become a slave.
Ekegusii: Ogochaberwa kwaye gwonsi kwarusiigwe na gosambwa; bono nomosomba na tori omochie omosibore naende.

English: Behold, our holy things, our beauty, and our glory are laid waste. The Gentiles have profaned them.
Ekegusii: Rora bono Hekalu yaito; tebwati obuya gose ogocheneka konde gwonsi, abanto b’ebisaku bayeturutumbire.

English: Why should we live any longer?”
Ekegusii: Ninki keragere intwe togenderere komenya?”

English: Mattathias and his sons tore their clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourned exceedingly.
Ekegusii: Erio Matathia na abana baye bagatandora chiaanga chiabo, bakeboyia chigunia na korera na amayianda amo no okweumia okonene.

English: And the king’s officers who were enforcing the apostasy came into the city Modin to sacrifice.
Ekegusii: Erio abateneneri bo omorwoti baria barenge kobabetereria abanto komotiga Omonene, bagaika ase omochie o Modeini kobabetereria abamenyi ba aroro gokora ekengwanso.

English: Many of Israel came to them, and Mattathias and his sons were gathered together.
Ekegusii: Abaisraeli abange bakabachera abanene abwo, ase egati yabwo, Matathia na abana baye.

English: The king’s officers answered and spoke to Mattathias, saying, “You are a ruler and an honorable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and kindred.
Ekegusii: Abanene b’omorwoti bakamoteebia Matathia, “Aye nomorai osikire ase omochie oyo, na nigo okobwatisegwa amo na abana ne eamate yao.

English: Now therefore come first and do the commandment of the king, as all the nations have done, including the men of Judah and those who remain in Jerusalem. You and your house will be numbered among the king’s friends, and you and your sons will be honored with silver and gold and many gifts.”
Ekegusii: Ninki keragere aye bono toba omotang’ani goikerania ogochika kwomorwoti? Rora abanto bonsi be ebisaku binde, abanto ba Yudea, na abanto bonsi batigarete Yerusalemu baikire goikerania ayio. Oise goikerania ogochika kwomorwoti, aye amo na abana bao nigo moraegwe esiko enene na korokwa abasani b’omorwoti,’ boigo inwe imoegwe efeta na etaabu amo nebiegwa ebinde ebinge.”

English: And Mattathias answered and said with a loud voice, “If all the nations that are in the house of the king’s dominion listen to him, to fall away each one from the worship of his fathers, and have chosen to follow his commandments,
Ekegusii: Matathia akairaneria ase eriogi rinene, “Neisa koba ebisaku bionsi bire inse yoborai bw’omorwoti biaikire koigwera na gokora ogochika kwomorwoti, na igo gotiga ogosasiima kwabo kwomochaakano,

English: yet I and my sons and my kindred will walk in the covenant of our fathers.
Ekegusii: inche na abana baane amo na bamura baminto nigo toragenderere gotunyana okobwatana ogochenu intwe twakorete n’Omonene oito.

English: Far be it from us that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.
Ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa n’Omonene oito, inwe titokonyaara gotuguta amachiiko aye, gose kobuna amachiiko aye Omonene oito nonya ng’ake.

English: We will not listen to the king’s words, to turn aside from our worship, to the right hand, or to the left.”
Ekegusii: Ogochika kwomorwoti titogokobwatia nonya ng’ake, na intwe titokoonchoreria ensemo enke yogosasiima gwaito!”

English: When he had finished speaking these words, a Jew came in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.
Ekegusii: Ekero Matathia are ang’e gochia gokoora enkwana yaye, Omoyahudi oyomo korwa ase eamate ya Modeini agesookia na korigia korwa ekeng’wanso igoro ase egesasiimero kiarenge ang’e agwo koreng’ana nogochika kwomorwoti.

English: Mattathias saw it, so his zeal was kindled, and his guts trembled, and he vented his wrath according to judgment, and ran and killed him upon the altar.
Ekegusii: Ekero Matathia amorora, ere agasambwa nobororo na enkoro yaye egaateka. Akanyegerigwa n’obororo akamochiera na komoita agwo agwo igoro ase egesasiimero.

English: He killed the king’s officer, who compelled men to sacrifice, at the same time, and pulled down the altar.
Ekegusii: Akamoita boigo omoteneneri bw’omorwoti oyio orenge kobabetereria abanto korwa ekeng’wanso na agwo akagetagora egesasiimero ekio.

English: He was zealous for the law, even as Phinehas did to Zimri the son of Salu.
Ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio Matathia agetogeria richiiko, buna boigo Finehasi nere aorogetie ekero amoitete Zimuri mosinto o Salu.

English: Mattathias cried out in the city with a loud voice, saying, “Whoever is zealous for the law and maintains the covenant, let him follow me!”
Ekegusii: Erio Matathia agaeta ase egati yomochie ogoaka eriogi: “Kera omonto osigete richiiko ri’Omonene oito na okobwatia okobwatana kwaye ogochenu antunyane!”

English: He and his sons fled into the mountains, and left all that they had in the city.
Ekegusii: Matathia bweka amo na abamura baye bagatama gochia igoro y’ebitunwa na gotiga bionsi ebio babwate ase omochie oyio.

English: Then many who sought justice and judgment went down into the wilderness to live there—
Ekegusii: Ase ebiro ebio, Abaisraeli bonsi baria barigetie gotunyana esiko yedini na amachiiko abo, bagatirimboka na koagaacha obomenyo bwabo ase chinsana,

English: they, their children, their wives, and their livestock—because evils were multiplied upon them.
Ekegusii: barabwo amo na abana baabo, abakungu baabo, ne chitugo chiabo ase engencho konye ogochaandwa kwabo kwabanyaarire.

English: It was told to the king’s officers and the forces that were in Jerusalem, the city of David, that certain men who had broken the king’s commandment had gone down into the secret places in the wilderness;
Ekegusii: Erio amang’ana akabaikera abateneneri b’omorwoti na abarwani esegi barenge Yerusalemu, Omochie o Daudi buna abanto batatagete koigwera ogochika kwomorwoti batamire na kwebisa erooro.

English: and many pursued after them, and having overtaken them, they encamped against them and set the battle in array against them on the Sabbath day.
Ekegusii: Abarwani abange be esegi bakababwatia, bakabanyoora na kwearigania kobaumokera ase rituko ri’Esabato.

English: They said to them, “Enough of this! Come out and do according to the word of the king, and you will all live!”
Ekegusii: Erio bakabateebia, “Bono aisanire! Soka isiko moikeranie ogochika kw’omorwoti nainwe motorie obogima bwaino.”

English: They said, “We won’t come out. We won’t do the word of the king, to profane the Sabbath day.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakairaneria, “Titogosooka nonya ng’ake! Boigo titokonyaara gokora ogochika kwomorwoti erio tosarie rituko ri’Esabato.”

English: Then the enemy hurried to attack them.
Ekegusii: Ekaba rimo rioka, ababisa abwo bagachaaka kobaumokera Abayahudi.

English: They didn’t answer them. They didn’t cast a stone at them, or block their secret places,
Ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi tibairaneria ase okoumokerwa okwo nonya nokoruta rigena gochia ase bare, gose kobatanga tibasoa ase ebiebisero biabo,

English: saying, “Let’s all die in our innocence. Heaven and earth testify for us, that you put us to death unjustly.”
Ekegusii: ekiagera bateebaanetie, Intwe tiga tokwe twensi nechinkoro chitari gotogaambia. Erio igoro na ense bienekie ase ribaga riaito buna nigo mogotoita ase enchera etari noboronge bonde bwonsi.

English: So they attacked them on the Sabbath, and they died—they, their wives, their children, and their livestock—in number a thousand souls of men.
Ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato, barabwo bagaita abanto 1,000, abasacha na abakungu amo na abana. Bagachisaamba chitugo boigo.

English: When Mattathias and his friends found out about it, they mourned over them exceedingly.
Ekegusii: Ekero Matathia amo na abamura baye baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakabareera mono abamwabo.

English: One said to another, “If we all do as our kindred have done, and don’t fight against the Gentiles for our lives and our ordinances, they will quickly destroy us from off the earth.”
Ekegusii: Erio kera omonto agateebia oyomwabo, “Tomochanie tokore buna abaaminto baakorete na totige titwerwanerera korwa ase ababisa baito ase okoegerera obogima bwaito, ase obwango barabwo nigo bagochia gotosiria korwa ase oboiko bw’ense.”

English: So they decided that day, saying, “Whoever comes against us to battle on the Sabbath day, let’s fight against him, and we will in no way all die, as our kindred died in the secret places.”
Ekegusii: Gochaakera rituko erio bagaetia ase obomo buna goika berwanerere eisa koba buna onde bwensi obagwereire ase rituko ri’Esabato egere tibacha goitwa bonsi buna abamwabo baitetwe agwo ase bebisete.

English: Then a company of the Hasidaeans, mighty men of Israel, everyone who offered himself willingly for the law, were gathered together to them.
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo bagasoa ase ekeombe kia Abahasidi abwo bebegete ang’e ase okorwanerera amachiiko abo naboigo abaremu kegima ase okorwana esegi.

English: All those who fled from the evils were added to them, and supported them.
Ekegusii: Ekaba kera omonto orenge kogania gotama korwa ase ogochaandwa, akabwatana ne ekeombe ekio erio kerokio gekagenderera gokiina.

English: They mustered an army, and struck sinners in their anger, and lawless men in their wrath. The rest fled to the Gentiles for safety.
Ekegusii: Erio barabwo bagasangereria abarwani be esegi, na ase ekeririanda bakabagwera Abayahudi abwo batasigete richiiko. Baria baruete monwa bagatama na kwebisa ime ase ebisaku binde.

English: And Mattathias and his friends went around and pulled down the altars.
Ekegusii: Matathia amo na abasani baye bagaeta aa na aaria na gotaagora ebisasimero bie chinyasae,

English: They forcibly circumcised the boys who were uncircumcised, as many as they found in the coasts of Israel.
Ekegusii: na kobaarokia ne chinguru abamura bonsi bare konyoora bataarokiri ime ya Israeli.

English: They pursued the arrogant, and the work prospered in their hand.
Ekegusii: Boigo bakabua kobabeeka biara abateneneri abatwambu b’omorwoti.

English: They rescued the law out of the hand of the Gentiles and out of the hand of the kings. They never allowed the sinner to triumph.
Ekegusii: Igo bakayatoria amachiiko a Musa korwa ase chinchera chia abanto be ebisaku binde na omorwoti oye, erio tibamotiga omonyabibe abue.

English: The days of Mattathias drew near that he should die, and he said to his sons, “Now pride and scorn have gained strength. It is a season of overthrow and indignant wrath.
Ekegusii: Ekero Matathia arooche buna amatuko aye yogokwa abereire ang’e, akabateebia abana baye: Bono endamwamu na amachaaya okire omorero. Echi bono ne chingaki chiogoita na egesiomba ekeroro!

English: Now, my children, be zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.
Ekegusii: Korende, inwe abana baane, goika mwerue ase engencho ya amachiiko na korua obogima bwaino ase engencho yokobwatana ogochenu kwa abagaaka baito.

English: Call to remembrance the deeds of our fathers which they did in their generations; and receive great glory and an everlasting name.
Ekegusii: Moinyore aria abagaaka baito bakorete ase chingaki chiabo nainwe inamoegwe egutwa yobonene na esiko etakoera.

English: Wasn’t Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness?
Ekegusii: Moinyore buna Aburahamu abeete omwegenwa ekero ere ateemetwe, erio agancherwa koba omoigweri.

English: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment, and became lord of Egypt.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu arenge ase emechaando, akaigwera amachiiko o Omonene, agakorwa koba omoteneneri bw’ense ya Misiri.

English: Phinehas our father, because he was exceedingly zealous, obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.
Ekegusii: Sokoro yaito Finehasi, ase engencho yogotaarera aria egenete, nigo arieretwe eira buna abaibori baye inababe abakuhani.

English: Joshua became a judge in Israel for fulfilling the word.
Ekegusii: Yoshua agakorwa koba omogambi ase egesaku kia Abaisraeli ase engencho aigwerete amachiiko.

English: Caleb obtained a heritage in the land for testifying in the congregation.
Ekegusii: Kalebu akarenta amairanerio amaya ase omosangererekano, ere akaegwa ensemo yendemero.

English: David inherited the throne of a kingdom forever and ever for being merciful.
Ekegusii: Daudi ere ase engencho areenge na amaabera, akaegwa ekerogo kiobogaambi getakoera.

English: Elijah was taken up into heaven because he was exceedingly zealous for the law.
Ekegusii: Elija, ase engencho yogotaarera amachiiko kegima, akabogorigwa gochia igoro.

English: Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael believed, and were saved out of the flame.
Ekegusii: Hanania, Asaria na Mishaeli bagatoorigwa korwa ase omorero ase engencho barenge abegenwa ase Omonene.

English: Daniel was delivered from the mouth of lions for his innocence.
Ekegusii: Danieli nigo arenge omonto omoigweri nere Omonene akamotoria korwa ase omonwa bw’echindo.

English: “Thus consider from generation to generation that no one who put their trust in him will lack for strength.
Ekegusii: Kera oyomo bwa abagaaka aba baito nomogwekano o maiso marore buna kera oyomo oria omosemeretie Omonene tana koborwa obokoonyi.

English: Don’t be afraid of the words of a sinful man; for his glory will be dung and worms.
Ekegusii: Timoiroka okogosererigwa kwomonto omobe. Moinyore buna ere boigo nakwe na obwerori bwaye bwonsi inabosire boigo omobere oye oguunde na koriegwa na amakonde.

English: Today he will be lifted up, and tomorrow he will in no way be found, because he has returned to dust, and his thought has perished.
Ekegusii: Nabo eranyaarekane ere atogigwe na koimokererigwa igoro, korende ankio arweo; omobere oye oirane gochia ase orotu na emeroberio yaye eerere ase embeo.

English: You, my children, be strong, and show yourselves men on behalf of the law; for in it you will obtain glory.
Ekegusii: Korende inwe, abana baane, mwee omoyo, motenene bokong’u ase okobwata amachiiko, ase engencho goetera ase amachiiko inamoegwe obonene n’esiko.

English: Behold, Simon your brother, whom I know to be a man of counsel. Always listen to him. He shall be a father to you.
Ekegusii: “Momura omino omonene Simioni nare nechisemi amo n’obong’aini. Igo inwe momoigwere buna mwarenge konyigwera inche iso.

English: Judas Maccabaeus has been strong and mighty from his youth. He shall be your captain and shall fight the battle of the people.
Ekegusii: Yuda Makabi obeire etwoni ase esegi korwa obosae bwaye; ere nabe omoteneneri oino ase esegi, na kobaraa ase okoamererania noria omobisa.

English: Rally around all the doers of the law, and avenge the wrong done to your people.
Ekegusii: Onde bwensi oria okobwatia amachiiko, moariganie abwatane nainwe; erio moakane egesiomba ase amabe aria abanto baino bakoreretwe.

English: Repay the Gentiles, and obey the commandments of the law.”
Ekegusii: Moakane kera egesaku ase aria babakorerete; naende mobwatie amachiiko ase amatuko onsi.”

English: He blessed them, and was gathered to his ancestors.
Ekegusii: Ekero abasesenirie, Matathia agakwa.

English: He died in the one hundred forty sixth year, and his sons buried him in the tombs of his ancestors at Modin. All Israel made great lamentation for him.
Ekegusii: Ere agatindekwa ase chimbeera chi’echisokoro chiaye aria Modeini na abanto bonsi ba Israeli bakamoreera. Ayio nigo akorekanete ase omwaka o 146.

English: His son Judas, who was called Maccabaeus, rose up in his place.
Ekegusii: Yuda, oyio naende omanyekanete buna Makabi akaira ribaga ria ise na Matathia akaba omoteneneri bw’abarwani b’esegi.

English: All his kindred helped him, and so did all those who joined with his father, and they fought with gladness the battle of Israel.
Ekegusii: Abamura bamwabo bonsi amo na ababwatani baabo abegeni bakamoa okoboko, nabarabwo bakebeeka ang’e ase okogendereria esegi ya Abaisraeli.

English: He got his people great glory, and put on a breastplate like a giant, and bound his warlike harness around him, and set battles in array, protecting the army with his sword.
Ekegusii: Yuda akamenta obonene bwa abanto baye. Buna etwoni, akeboyia egiekengero kia gekuba, akabogoria ebirwanero na koraa esegi; na ase omoro oye akarenda ekambi yaye.

English: He was like a lion in his deeds, and like a lion’s cub roaring for prey.
Ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge buna endo ase amakora aye, buna endo ensae ekoruma ekero egotwara.

English: He hunted and pursued the lawless, and he burned up those who troubled his people.
Ekegusii: Akabarigia akabatunyana abwo barenge gosaria amachiiko; akabasamba n’omorero abwo barenge kounereria abanto baye.

English: The lawless shrunk back for fear of him, and all the workers of lawlessness were very troubled, and deliverance prospered in his hand.
Ekegusii: Abagosaria amachiiko bagakwa omoyo ase okomoiroka Yuda; ababe bonsi bakaigusigwa na gotutukana; ase amakora aye akarwanerera na goikerania obosibore.

English: He angered many kings and made Jacob glad with his acts. His memory is blessed forever.
Ekegusii: Akabageechia abarwoti abange, korende amakora aye akabagokia abanto ba Yakobo; ase ayio ere naimokererigwe igoro kare na kare.

English: He went through the cities of Judah, destroyed the ungodly out of the land, and turned away wrath from Israel.
Ekegusii: Akagenda aa na aaria ase emechie ya Yudea, na kobasiria bonsi baria batamoirogete Omonene; na gotanga Israeli korwa ase endamwamu y’Omonene.

English: He was renowned to the utmost part of the earth. He gathered together those who were ready to perish.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense; akabasangereria bonsi baria konye basirire.

English: Apollonius gathered the Gentiles together with a great army from Samaria to fight against Israel.
Ekegusii: Korende Apolonio agasangereria abanto be ebisaku binde, ase egati yabwo ekeombe ekenene korwa Samaria, erio bayegwere Israeli.

English: Judas learned of it, and he went out to meet him, struck him, and killed him. Many fell wounded to death, and the rest fled.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuda anyoorete amang’ana ayio, agasooka na korwana ne ekeombe ekio; agakebua na komoita Apolonio. Ababisa abange bagaakwa chingoma na abande baabo bagachia bichuko.

English: They took their spoils, and Judas took Apollonius’ sword, and he fought with it all his days.
Ekegusii: Ase egati yebisakorwa biatogete, Yuda akaira omoro bwa Apolonio, oyio akorerete emeremo ase amatuko onsi yobogima bwaye.

English: Seron, the commander of the army of Syria, heard that Judas had gathered a large company, including a body of faithful men who stayed with him, went out to war.
Ekegusii: Seroni, omoteneneri bwa abarwani esegi ba Siria, akanyoora amang’ana buna Yuda osangereirie abarwani esegi abegenwa baye abwo bebegete ang’e korwana inse yoborai bwaye.

English: He said, “I will make myself a name and get myself glory in the kingdom. I will fight against Judas and those who are with him, who despise the king’s command.
Ekegusii: Erio Seroni agakwana ase omoyo oye, “Inche ninyenyoorere erieta na esiko ase oborwoti obo eisa koba namorwanirie na goita abarwani baye abwo batari abaigweri ase ogochika kwo omorwoti.”

English: A mighty army of the ungodly went up with him to help him, to take vengeance on the children of Israel.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani abaange ase ekeombe keria getamoirogeti Omonene bakabwatana nere ase okomobwatesia goakana egesiomba ase Abaisraeli.

English: He came near to the ascent of Bethhoron, and Judas went out to meet him with a small company.
Ekegusii: Ekero Seroni abaange ne ebitiiro bia Beth-horoni, Yuda akamochiera ore nekeombe kiabarwani egeke.

English: But when they saw the army coming to meet them, they said to Judas, “What? Shall we be able, being a small company, to fight against so great and strong a multitude? We for our part are faint, having tasted no food this day.”
Ekegusii: Korende ekero abanto ba Yuda barooche abarwani b’ababisa bakobaachera, bakamoteebia Yuda: “Inaki eranyaarekane intwe korwana nekeombe ekenene buna eke kiabarwani ase abarwani baito abake? Tari igo rioka, omobaso omogima intwe titoraria gento na titobwati kende!”

English: Judas said, “It is an easy thing for many to be hemmed in by the hands of a few. With heaven it is all one, to save by many or by few;
Ekegusii: Yuda akabairaneria, Teri akong’u ase abarwani abake kobua abarwani abange. Ase Omonene gwatanana tikoiyo buna totoorigwe na abanto abange gose bake igo.

English: for victory in battle stands not in the multitude of an army, but strength is from heaven.
Ekegusii: Obobui ase esegi tibiri korengwa na obonge bwa abarwani korende obobui nigo bokorwa igoro.

English: They come to us in fullness of insolence and lawlessness, to destroy us and our wives and our children, and to plunder us,
Ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo bagotochera nokogosa amo negekuba, nigo basemeretie gosakora chinibo chiaito naende boigo goita abakungu amo na abana baito.

English: but we fight for our lives and our laws.
Ekegusii: Korende intwe nigo tokorwana toegerere obogima na amachiiko y’Omonene oito.

English: He himself will crush them before our face; but as for you, don’t be afraid of them.
Ekegusii: Omonene omonyene nabakoore ababisa baito. “Ase igo inwe timobaisa kobairoka.”

English: Now when he had finished speaking, he rushed suddenly against Seron and his army, and they were defeated before him.
Ekegusii: Erio kegima gakoorire gokwana amang’ana ayio, Yuda amo na abanto baye bakamogwera Seroni na abarwani baye, bakabasegenya.

English: They pursued them down the descent of Bethhoron to the plain, and about eight hundred men of them fell; but the rest fled into the land of the Philistines.
Ekegusii: Bakababwatia goetera ase ebitirimboko bia Beth-horoni goika omweya. Agwo bagaita abanto 800, na abande bagatama gochia ase ense ya Abafilisiti.

English: The fear of Judas and his kindred, and the dread of them, began to fall on the nations around them.
Ekegusii: Magega yayio, abanto be ebisaku binde kera ensemo bagachaaka komoiroka Yuda na abamura bamwabo.

English: His fame reached the king, and every nation told of the battles of Judas.
Ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Yuda chikamoikera omorwoti Antioko, na abanto be ebisaku bakaba bagokwana igoro y’obobui bwa Yuda.

English: But when King Antiochus heard these words, he was full of indignation; and he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, an exceedingly strong army.
Ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Antioko anyoorete amang’ana ayio, akageechigwa mono. Agachiika abarwani esegi baye bonsi basangererekane na koroisia ekeombe ekenene gieseegi.

English: He opened his treasury and gave his forces pay for a year, and commanded them to be ready for every need.
Ekegusii: Agataoria chitaabu korwa ase ekegancha kiaye na goakana abarwani abwo eng’eria y’omwaka omogima na kobachiika bebeke ang’e ase mobasokano onde bwensi orabeo.

English: He saw that the money was gone from his treasures, and that the tributes of the country were small, because of the dissension and disaster which he had brought upon the land, to the end that he might take away the laws which had been from the first days.
Ekegusii: Erio akanyoora buna ekegancha kiaye nigo kere bosa na tikeri naende na emonga yechitaabu. Okonyora kwe ebaango konye kwaguure ase engencho ye chiburuburu ne chiseegi echi chiachete ase okoruusi richiiko erio riarenge kogambera abanto korwa emiaka ne emiaka.

English: He was afraid that he wouldn’t have enough as at other times for the charges and the gifts which he used to give with a liberal hand, more abundantly than the kings who were before him.
Ekegusii: Agasogwa nobwoba buna naborwe chitaabu chiogoakanera emeroberio yokogendereria oborai bwaye, na buna tarenge gochia konyora enchera yokorwa ebiegwa aande onsi igo buna enaretie ekiagera ere nigo arenge omosiboku korua kobua abarwoti bonsi abwo bamotang’anerete.

English: And he was exceedingly perplexed in his mind, and he determined to go into Persia, and to take the tributes of those countries, and to gather much money.
Ekegusii: Akegosa mono. Omoerio agaetia agende Persia achie gosangereria ebango ase orogongo orwo erio enyorere omosamogoko bwe chibeesa.

English: He left Lysias, an honorable man, and one of royal lineage, to be over the affairs of the king from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt,
Ekegusii: Akamochoora Lisia, omonto omanyekanete korwa ase eamate yomorwoti, ere abe omoteneneri bw’omorwoti ase ensemo eyio yonsi gochaakera orooche rwe Eyufurate goika orobebe rwa Misiri.

English: and to bring up his son Antiochus, until he came again.
Ekegusii: Boigo akamobeka abe omorendi bw’omwana oye Antioko o gatano goika oiranire ere omonyene.

English: He delivered to Lysias half of his forces and the elephants, and gave him charge of all the things that he would have done, and concerning those who lived in Judea and in Jerusalem,
Ekegusii: Akamobeka Lisia abe omorigereria bwe chinchogu chionsi na boigo omoteneneri bw’ekeng’ese ekemo kiabarwani baye be esegi. Boigo akamoa chinkwana chinyikeranu igoro y’amang’ana ere atagete akoreke na mono aria aganetie bakorerwe abamenyi ba Yudea na Yerusalemu.

English: that he should send an army against them to root out and destroy the strength of Israel and the remnant of Jerusalem, and to take away their memory from the place,
Ekegusii: Lisia agachiikwa abogorie abarwani esegi babagwere Abayahudi, mono Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu, erio babune chinguru chiabo, babasirie na kobaabusa kegima korwa ase oboiko bw’ense.

English: and that he should make foreigners live in all their territory, and should divide their land to them by lot.
Ekegusii: Agachiikwa abaure chindemero chiabo erio chiegwe abamenyi abwo baramenye orogongo orwo rwonsi.

English: The king took the half that remained of the forces, and left Antioch, his royal city, in the one hundred forty seventh year; and he passed over the river Euphrates, and went through the upper countries.
Ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akarua ase omochie oye omonene Antiokia nekeng’ese kiabarwani esegi baye ase omwaka o 147. Akamboka orooche rwa Eyufurate, agaetera ase chingongo chi’ebitunwa.

English: Lysias chose Ptolemy the son of Dorymenes, Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king’s friends;
Ekegusii: Lisia akabachoora Tolemai mosinto o Dorimene, Nikanori na Ggorigia, abanto ebiata ase egati ya abasani b’omorwoti.

English: and with them, he sent forty thousand infantry and seven thousand cavalry to go into the land of Judah and to destroy it, according to the word of the king.
Ekegusii: Akabatoma bagende basirie ense ya Yuda buna omorwoti amochiigete. Akabaa abachiiki abwo b’esegi abarwani esegi bagochiera amagoro 40,000, na abagochira chibaarasi 7,000.

English: They set out with all their army, and came and encamped near Emmaus in the plain country.
Ekegusii: Bonsi bagasooka na kobeka ekambi yabo ang’e ne Emau ase omweya.

English: The merchants of the country heard of their fame, and took silver and gold in large quantities, and fetters, and came into the camp to take the children of Israel for slaves. Forces of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined with them.
Ekegusii: Abaonchoreria benseemo eyio, abwo bang’usetwe n’amang’ana banyoorete kobwatekana na abarwani esegi abwo bakabogoria chitaabu chi’etaabu chinyinge amo nemenyororo bakagenda ase ekambi erio babaire Abaisraeli bachie koba abasomba baabo. Ebiombe bi’abarwani esegi bia Siria na Filisiti boigo bigaacha kobwatana na abarwani abwo.

English: Judas and his kindred saw that evils were multiplied, and that the forces were encamping in their borders. They learned about the king’s words which he had commanded, to destroy the people and make an end of them.
Ekegusii: Yuda na bamura bamwabo bakarora buna ebinto biagendereire koba ebikong’u. Abarwani esegi ba ababisa konye babeekire ekambi ase ense yaabo. Na omorwoti ochiikire buna barabwo basirigwe kegima.

English: Then they each said to his neighbor, “Let’s repair the ruins of our people. Let’s fight for our people and the holy place.”
Ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagateebania, Bono tiga toagaache oboyia egesaku giaito! Torwane toegerere abanto baito na egesasiimero giaito.

English: The congregation was gathered together, that they might be ready for battle, and that they might pray and ask for mercy and compassion.
Ekegusii: Erio ekeombe ekegima kegasangererekana na kwebeeka ang’e ase esegi ase ogosaba Omonene abakwere mabera na abaabere.

English: Jerusalem was without inhabitant like a wilderness. There was none of her offspring who went in or went out. The sanctuary was trampled down. Children of foreigners were in the citadel. The Gentiles lived there. Joy was taken away from Jacob, and the pipe and the harp ceased.
Ekegusii: Omochie o Yerusalemu nigo okamogete buna erooro; tarengeo omomenyi oye ore gosoka gose gosoa omochie. Hekalu nigo yabegetwe ogotacheneka na abageni; abamenyi nigo nabwo bayotenenerete na abanto be ebisaku nabwo bamenyeteo. Omosasoko nigo obarwete abanto ba Yakobo; tikwarengeo okobugigwa gwechisirimbi gose amakano.

English: They gathered themselves together, and came to Mizpeh, near Jerusalem; for in Mizpeh there used to be a place of prayer for Israel.
Ekegusii: Ekaba abanto ba Yuda bakaumerana na kogenda sobo Mizipa ang’e na Yerusalemu ase engencho ase amatuko a magega, Abaisraeli mbabwate ase bare gosasiimera agwo Mizipa.

English: They fasted that day, put on sackcloth, put ashes on their heads, tore their clothes,
Ekegusii: Bakeng’ata ase rituko erio na kweboyia chianga chi’echigunia, bakeaka riibu ase emetwe yaabo na gotandora chianga chiabo.

English: and opened the book of the law, to learn about the things for which the Gentiles consulted the images of their idols.
Ekegusii: Ase amang’ana anga buna ayio, nigo yarenge kobabetereria abanto b’ebisaku korangeria chinyasae chiabo erio chibateebie engencho yaye, korende Abaisraeli bagasokia egetabu kia amachiiko erio banyoore oboseemia korwa ase Omonene.

English: They brought the priests’ garments, the first fruits, and the tithes. They stirred up the Nazarites, who had accomplished their days.
Ekegusii: Bakarenta emiambaro ya abakuhani, okorua kwe rigesa riogotongora na ensemo ya ikomi. Naende bakarenta baria batakeire bagaikerania ogotakerwa kwabo.

English: They cried aloud toward heaven, saying, “What should we do with these men? Where should we carry them away?
Ekegusii: Bono omosangererekano bwonsi ogasaba ase eriogi bagoteeba: “Ninki tokobakorera abatakerwa aba? Ng’ai tokobaira bono?

English: Your holy place is trampled down and profaned. Your priests mourn in humiliation.
Ekegusii: Hekalu yao yatiringirwe ase obochaayi na kobekwa ogotacheneka, na abakuani bao nigo bakorera ase omoroso.

English: Behold, the Gentiles are assembled together against us to destroy us. You know what things they imagine against us.
Ekegusii: Rora bono, abanto b’ebisaku basangererekanire batosirie; naye nomanyete emeroberio eyio emebe bakorire mamincha yaito.

English: How will we be able to stand against them, unless you help us?”
Ekegusii: Inaki intwe toranyare koamererania nabarabwo onye aye togotokoonya?”

English: They sounded with the trumpets, and gave a loud shout.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabugia rirandi na gokuura neriogi rinene.

English: And after this Judas appointed leaders of the people: captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, and captains of tens.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akabaatanana abanto baye ase ebiombe bia abanto ikomi ikomi, emerongo etano, rigana na elifu elifu. Ere boigo akabeeka kera ekeombe inse y’omorai gete.

English: He said to those who were building houses, were betrothing wives, were planting vineyards, and were fearful, that they should return, each man to his own house, according to the law.
Ekegusii: Erio kobwatekana ne richiiko, akabairania gochia inka oria orenge koagacha enyomba, oyo konye onywomire ase obwango obwo, oyo orenge komeria chintetere chi’emesabibu gose oria orenge omwoba.

English: The army marched out and encamped upon the south side of Emmaus.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani b’esegi ba Yuda bagasooka na kobeeka ekambi isiko ensemo ya Irianyi y’omochie bwe Emau.

English: Judas said, “Arm yourselves and be valiant men! Be ready in the morning to fight with these Gentiles who are assembled together against us to destroy us and our holy place.
Ekegusii: Agwo Yuda akabateebia abanto baye, “Ebeeke ang’e ase esegi! Eremie! Ankio mambia chuni mobe ang’e kobaita abanto aba b’ebisaku binde abwo basangerekanire erio batorwanie na gotosiria intwe twensi amo ne Hekalu yaito.

English: For it is better for us to die in battle than to see the calamities of our nation and the holy place.
Ekegusii: Nigo ere buya intwe tokwe ase esegi kobua gotengera ogosambwa kwe egesaku giaito amo ne Hekalu yaito.

English: Nevertheless, as may be the will in heaven, so shall he do.
Ekegusii: Korende Omonene ere oyio ore igoro nakore buna aganetie omonyene.”

English: Gorgias took five thousand infantry, a thousand chosen cavalry, and the army moved out at night,
Ekegusii: Georigia akababogoria abarwani esegi bagochiera amagoro 5,000 na baria bagochiera chibaarasi 1,000, akageenda nabwo botuko

English: that it might fall upon the army of the Jews and strike them suddenly. The men of the citadel were his guides.
Ekegusii: erio abagwere abarwani esegi ba Abayahudi; baria babaraete ase enchera mbaria barenge abarendi orwaki rwa Yerusalemu.

English: Judas heard of this, and he and the valiant men moved, that he might strike the king’s army which was at Emmaus
Ekegusii: Korende Yuda akamanya omoroberio oyio, agasooka amo na abanto baye erio babagwere abarwani esegi b’omorwoti aria Emau

English: while the forces were still dispersed from the camp.
Ekegusii: ekero Georigia na abarwani esegi baye bataraika ase ekambi ime.

English: Gorgias came into the camp of Judas at night and found no man. He sought them in the mountains; for he said, “These men are running away from us.”
Ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Georigia na abarwani esegi baye baika ekaaambi ya Yuda ase obotuko obwo. Tibanyoora monto onde aroro. Bagachaaka kobarigia igoro ase ebitunwa, ekiagera bakagete buna nigo baatamete.

English: As soon as it was day, Judas appeared in the plain with three thousand men. However they didn’t have the armor and swords they desired.
Ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokiamoka, Yuda agasooka korwa ase omweya ore na abanto 3,000, korende barabwo tibabwate ebirwanero bibaisaine.

English: They saw the camp of the Gentiles strong and fortified, with cavalry all around it; and these were expert in war.
Ekegusii: Erio bakarora riicho riabarwani esegi b’ebisaku binde ebiata ase esegi bating’ete ebirwanero, na barabwo nigo bagiteire gati na abasigari bariinete chibaarasi.

English: Judas said to the men who were with him, “Don’t be afraid of their numbers, or when they charge.
Ekegusii: Korende Yuda akabateebia abanto baye, “Inwe timobaisa koiroka igoro yobonene bwa abarwani esegi baabo, gose kwoboa ekero bakobagwera.

English: Remember how our fathers were saved in the Red sea, when Pharaoh pursued them with an army.
Ekegusii: Inyora buna chisokoro chiaito chiatoretigwe ase enyancha ya Shamu ekero Farao ababwatetie ere amo na abarwani esegi baye!

English: Now let’s cry to heaven, if he will have us, and will remember the covenant of our fathers, and destroy this army before our face today.
Ekegusii: Bono tiga tomosabe Omonene atokwere amaabera. Tiga tosambe erio ere ainyore okobwatana ogochenu koria akorete ne chisokoro chiaito na kobasenyenta abarwani esegi abwo bare ase obosio bwaito.

English: Then all the Gentiles will know that there is one who redeems and saves Israel.
Ekegusii: Erio nario abanto bonsi be ebisaku baramanye buna nareo oyio okobatooria na kobarwanera Abaisraeli.”

English: The foreigners lifted up their eyes, and saw them coming near them.
Ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo be ebisaku barigereretie bakarora Yuda okobaachera na abanto baye,

English: They went out of the camp to battle. Those who were with Judas sounded their trumpets
Ekegusii: bagasoka korwa ase ekambi yabo erio barwane esegi. Yuda na abanto baye bakabugi rirandi

English: and joined battle. The Gentiles were defeated, and fled into the plain.
Ekegusii: na gochaaka kobaumokera. Ababisa bagasebererekana na gosoa ase omweya,

English: But all those in the rear fell by the sword. They pursued them to Gazara, and to the plains of Idumaea, Azotus, and Jamnia. About three thousand of those men fell.
Ekegusii: na abasikari baabo bonsi barenge ase omositari o magega bagaitwa nemioro. Abaisraeli bakabaseria ababisa abwo goika Gazara n’omweya o Idumea, goika Ashidodi na Yamunia. Ababisa 3,000 bagasira.

English: Then Judas and his army returned from pursuing them;
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda na abarwani baye be esegi bagatiga kobaminyokia, barabwo bakairana magega.

English: and he said to the people, “Don’t be greedy for the spoils, because there is a battle before us.
Ekegusii: Yuda akabateebia abanto baye, timobaisa koayerera ebisakorwa. Ntogendererete ne esegi.

English: Gorgias and his army are near us on the mountain. But stand now against our enemies and fight against them, and afterwards take the spoils with boldness.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akabateebia naende abanto baye, Timwegosa ase obonge bwa abarwani baye be esegi baabo, gose kwoboa ekero barabagwere. Yuda akabateebia naende abanto baye, Timwegosa ase obonge bwa abarwani baye be esegi baabo, gose kwoboa ekero barabagwere.

English: While Judas was finishing this speech, a part of them appeared looking out from the mountain.
Ekegusii: Yuda atarakoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, ekeombe kia abarwani be esegi ba ababisa gekabaorokera, kegosomoka korwa ebitunwa igoro.

English: They saw that their army had been put to flight, and that the Jews were burning the camp; for the smoke that was seen declared what was done.
Ekegusii: Erio gekamanya buna abarwani baye be esegi nigo baseretigwe naende goetera ase erioki barooche, Abayahudi nomorero barenge kobeka ase ekambi yekeombe ekio.

English: But when they perceived these things, they were very afraid. Perceiving also the army of Judas in the plain ready for battle,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakabwatwa no obwoba obonene. Ekero barooche engencho abarwani ba Yuda be esegi beroberetie ase anse eyio omweya, baganyete esegi,

English: they all fled into the land of the Philistines.
Ekegusii: bonsi bagatama gochi ense ya Abafilisiti.

English: Judas returned to plunder the camp, and they took much gold, silver, blue, sea purple, and great riches.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akairana akaira ekambi eyio ya ababisa; bakanyoora etaabu ne chifeta chinyinge, chianga chia buluu na echia monyiinga ne chinibo chinyinge.

English: Then they returned home, and sang a song of thanksgiving, and gave praise to heaven, because he is good, because his mercy endures forever.
Ekegusii: Ekero barenge koirana gochia ase ekambi yaabo, Abayahudi bagateera ogoteera gwokomotogia Omonene bagoteeba: “Ekiagera ere nomuya na amaabera aye nigo agendererete botambe.”

English: Israel had a great deliverance that day.
Ekegusii: Ekaba Israeli ekanyoora ogotooreka okonene rituko erio.

English: The foreigners who had escaped came and told Lysias all the things that had happened.
Ekegusii: Abarwani baria be esegi be ebisaku binde abwo baminchoretie bakamochiera Lisia na komomanyia onsi aria akorekanete.

English: When he heard of it, he was confounded and discouraged, because the things he desired had not been done to Israel, nor had such things happened as the king commanded him.
Ekegusii: Ekero Lisia aigwete ayio, ere akanyegerigwa mono na gokwa omoyo, ase engencho Abaisraeli tibaitetwe buna ere akagerete gose konyorwa na aria achiigete ase bare.

English: In the next year, he gathered together sixty thousand chosen infantry and five thousand cavalry, that he might subdue them.
Ekegusii: Ase omwaka obwatetie, Lisia agasangereria abarwani be esegi bakogenda na amagoro 60,000 na abagochiera chibaarasi 5,000 erio ababue Abayahudi.

English: They came into Idumaea and encamped at Bethsura. Judas met them with ten thousand men.
Ekegusii: Bagasoa Idumea na kobeeka ekambi Beth-zuri. Yuda amo na abasikari 10,000, agacha koamererania nabarabwo.

English: He saw that the army was strong, and he prayed and said, “Blessed are you, O Savior of Israel, who defeated the attack of the mighty warrior by the hand of your servant David, and delivered the army of the Philistines into the hands of Jonathan the son of Saul, and of his armor bearer.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuda arooche buna abarwani be esegi ba ababisa nigo bare ne chinguru, agasaba, ogoteeba: “Otogigwe aye Omotooria bwa Abaisraeli, ere oria otenenetie esegi ye rimonto riria ase okoboko kwomosomba oo Daudi okabeeka abarwani be esegi ba Abafilisiti ase okoboko kwa Yonathani mosinto o Saulo nomosae oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero biaye.

English: Hem in this army in the hand of your people Israel, and let them be ashamed for their army and their cavalry.
Ekegusii: Bono obagoyie boigo abarwani aba b’esegi ase okoboko kwa abanto bao Abaisraeli, obakore abanto baabo barore obosooku ase abasikari baabo bagochiera amagoro nabwo bagochiera chibaarasi.

English: Give them faintness of heart. Cause the boldness of their strength to melt away, and let them quake at their destruction.
Ekegusii: Obaichorie obwoba bonyititore obonyankongo bw’echinguru chiabo, batengechigwe ase ogosirigwa.

English: Strike them down with the sword of those who love you, and let all who know your name praise you with thanksgiving.”
Ekegusii: Obaiyerie inse ase omoro bwa baria bagwanchete, na kobakora bonsi baria barimanyete erieta riao bagotogie ase chingeero.”

English: They joined in battle; and about five thousand men of Lysias’ army fell. They fell down near them.
Ekegusii: Erio esegi egachaaka; ase okoamererania, bagaita abanto 5,000 ba Lisia.

English: But when Lysias saw that his troops were put to flight, and the boldness that had come upon those who were with Judas, and how they were ready either to live or to die nobly, he withdrew to Antioch, and gathered together hired soldiers, that he might come again into Judea with an even greater army.
Ekegusii: Ekero Lisia arooche abarwani baye be esegi baengeirwe na kwerorera oboremu Yuda amo na abanto baye, abwo barorekanete buna nigo beruete gokwa gose komenya ase okoegerera endemero yaabo ere akairana Antiokia. Agwo akabariika abasikari bogokomboa, erio agende Yudea naende kabwate abarwani be esegi abange kobua.

English: But Judas and his kindred said, “Behold, our enemies are defeated. Let’s go up to cleanse the holy place and to rededicate it.”
Ekegusii: Yuda na abamura bamwabo bagateeba: “Bono ababisa baito babuirwe. Tiga togende seito Yerusalemu tochene Hekalu na koyeiranera boyia.”

English: All the army was gathered together, and they went up to mount Zion.
Ekegusii: Erio abarwani be esegi bonsi bagasangererekana bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Sayoni.

English: They saw the sanctuary laid desolate, the altar profaned, the gates burned up, shrubs growing in the courts as in a forest or as on one of the mountains, and the priests’ chambers pulled down;
Ekegusii: Aroro agwo abanto bakayenyora Hekalu nigo etigire birati, egesasiimero kiaye kiabekirwe ogotacheneka, ebisieri biaye nigo biasaambire nomorero, chinyasi chiaye chiamerire abonyansi n’ebisarara biamerire buna biria bire orosana nase ebitunwa, nechinyomba chia abakuani chiatagoirwe.

English: and they tore their clothes, made great lamentation, put ashes upon their heads,
Ekegusii: Barabwo bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakarera na kweumia ase obororo obonene, na kweaka riibu ase emetwe yaabo.

English: fell on their faces to the ground, blew with the solemn trumpets, and cried toward heaven.
Ekegusii: Bakagwa inse maumama. Ekero rirandi riabugetigwe buna ekeinyorio, kera oyomo akamoreera Omonene.

English: Then Judas appointed certain men to fight against those who were in the citadel until he had cleansed the holy place.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda agachiika abande ase abasikari baye babagwere abanto barenge ase chinyasi erio ekero ere agendererete gochena Hekalu.

English: He chose blameless priests who were devoted to the law;
Ekegusii: Akabachoora abakuani baisaine naende babwatete richiiko boronge.

English: and they cleansed the holy place and carried the defiled stones out to an unclean place.
Ekegusii: Barabwo bakayechena Hekalu, bakabogoria amagena ayio konye abekirwe ogotacheneka na koyaira isiko ase eubi yarenge gotugutwa.

English: They deliberated what to do with the altar of burnt offerings, which had been profaned.
Ekegusii: Bakaborania eki bagokora ase egesasiimero kiogosaambera ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa, ekio kiabegetwe ogotacheneka.

English: A good plan came into their mind, that they should pull it down, lest it would be a reproach to them, because the Gentiles had defiled it. So they pulled down the altar
Ekegusii: Bagaetia buna nigo ere buya kogetagora, kobua kerokio gotigara ime ye Hekalu na kobarentera okoramwa ase engencho abanto be ebisaku konye bakebekire ogotacheneka. Bagatagora egesasiimero ekio

English: and laid up the stones on the temple hill in a convenient place, until a prophet would come to give an answer concerning them.
Ekegusii: na koyagacha amagena aye ase agaya igoro ase egetunwa gie Hekalu, goika omobani anyorekane oyio orabateebie ekio kegokorerwa amagena ayio.

English: They took whole stones according to the law, and built a new altar like the former.
Ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria amagena atabaachiri, kobwatekana namachiiko, bakaagacha egesasiimero ekeyia buna kiarenge keria egekoro.

English: They built the holy place and the inner parts of the house; and they consecrated the courts.
Ekegusii: Boigo bakabareera Hekalu, ime na isiko na gochena chinyasi chiaye.

English: They made new holy vessels, and they brought the lampstand, the altar of incense, and the table into the temple.
Ekegusii: Bakaroisia ebibekerero ebiyia ase engencho yogosasiima, na gosoyia ime ye Hekalu, ekebekerero gieteya, egesasiimero kia ubani, naboigo emesa yemegati.

English: They burned incense on the altar, and they lit the lamps that were upon the lampstand, and they gave light in the temple.
Ekegusii: Bagauterera ubani igoro ase egesasiimero na gotongia etaya igoro ase ekebekerero kiaye erio binyare korenta oborabu ime ye Hekalu.

English: They set loaves upon the table, hung up the curtains, and finished all the work which they had done.
Ekegusii: Bakabeka emegati emesa igoro, bakabeeka ebitamba biogotuba na gokora emeremo yonsi barabwo baroberetie gokora.

English: They rose up early in the morning, on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month, which is the month Chislev, in the one hundred forty eighth year,
Ekegusii: Mambia chuni, ase rituko riemerongo ebere na gatano riomotienyi o kianda engencho yaye, omotienyi o Kisilevu, omwaka o 148,

English: and offered sacrifice according to the law on the new altar of burnt offerings which they had made.
Ekegusii: bakabooka na korua ekeng’wanso kobwatekana na amachiiko igoro ase egesasiimero ekeyia ekio baagachete.

English: At the time and day the Gentiles had profaned it, even then it was dedicated with songs, harps, lutes, and with cymbals.
Ekegusii: Ase igo bagatenenia egesasiimero ekeyia ase ogoteera nechingeero, ne ebinubi, boigo ebinanda na amakano, ase chingaki echio echio na ase obotuko obwo obwo kerokio kiabegetwe ogotacheneka na abanto b’ebisaku binde ase omwaka oyomo korwa magega.

English: All the people fell on their faces, worshiped, and gave praise toward heaven, which had given them good success.
Ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakagwa inse maumama, bakamosasiima Omonene oyio obabuerete ayio.

English: They celebrated the dedication of the altar eight days, and offered burnt offerings with gladness, and sacrificed a sacrifice of deliverance and praise.
Ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na atato, bagakuberia rituko rinene riokweinyoria egesasiimero, bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosaambwa ase omogooko na korwa ekeng’wanso kiogotooreka na okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

English: They decorated the front of the temple with crowns of gold and small shields. They dedicated the gates and the priests’ chambers, and made doors for them.
Ekegusii: Bagachabera chinyasi chiamotwe chie Hekalu ne egutwa ye etaabu ne chinguba chinke chinke; bakaroisia ebisieri bie Hekalu; bakaagacha chinyomba chi’abakuani boyia na gochibeka ebisieri.

English: There was exceedingly great gladness among the people, and the reproach of the Gentiles was turned away.
Ekegusii: Abanto bakagooka mono na obosooku boria bwarentetwe ne ebisaku binde bokarwao.

English: Judas and his kindred and the whole congregation of Israel ordained that the days of the dedication of the altar should be kept in their seasons from year to year for eight days, from the twenty-fifth day of the month Chislev, with gladness and joy.
Ekegusii: Omoerio, Yuda na abamura bamwabo boigo na omosangererekano bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli bagaetia buna kera omwaka, ebiro buna ebio, ebe kegokoreka naende ase omogooko na gochenga, omoyega bwokweinyoria egesasiimero ase ebiro bi’amatuko atano na atato, gochaakera rituko riemerongo ebere na gatano riomotienyi o Kisilevu.

English: At that time, they fortified mount Zion with high walls and strong towers around it, lest perhaps the Gentiles might come and trample them down, as they had done before.
Ekegusii: Bakaagacha enyasi entambe ne emetobwa emekong’u eetananete egetunwa gia Sayoni, erio gotanga abanto b’ebisaku binde tibasoa naende na koyetiringa buna konye bakorire.

English: Judas stationed a garrison to guard it. They fortified Bethsura to keep it, that the people might have a stronghold near Idumaea.
Ekegusii: Yuda akabeeka ekeombe kiabarwani be esegi kiabasikari korenda Hekalu. Boigo akayokong’ia omochie o Beth-zuri, erio abanto ba Israeli babe negesieri ekemo giokorwania Idumea.

English: It came to pass, when the Gentiles all around heard that the altar had been rebuilt and the sanctuary dedicated as before, they were exceedingly angry.
Ekegusii: Ekero ebisaku bibebekaine biaigwete buna Abayahudi baagachire egesasiimero kiabo boyia na buna Hekalu yaigoirwe buna yarenge omochakano, bakaberorokwa nekeririanda,

English: They took counsel to destroy the race of Jacob that was in the midst of them, and they began to kill and destroy among the people.
Ekegusii: bagaetia kobasiria abaibore ba Yakobo abwo bamenyete ase egati yaabo. Erio bagachaaka goita na gosaria chinibo chi’abaanto.

English: Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumaea at Akrabattine, because they besieged Israel. He struck them with a great slaughter, humbled them, and took their spoils.
Ekegusii: Aria Akrabatene, Idumea, basinto be Esau nigo babeete bakobachaanda Abaisraeli. Erio Yuda akabarwania esegi na kobasiria kegima, akabaringania na gosakora chinibo chiabo.

English: He remembered the wickedness of the children of Baean, who were a snare and a stumbling block to the people, lying in wait for them on the highways.
Ekegusii: Boigo tabeeba basinto ba Baeani abwo bareenge okoirokia na omotego ase Abaisraeli, ase engencho barabwo bareenge kobaboera na kobaumokera Abaisraeli ase chinchera.

English: They were shut up by him in the towers. He encamped against them, and destroyed them utterly, and burned with fire the towers of the place with all who were in them.
Ekegusii: Yuda akabagitera Ababaeani ime yebiita biabo, akaria eira yokobasiria, agachisamba chimbago chiabo na kobasamba bonsi abwo barenge imeo.

English: He passed over to the children of Ammon, and found a mighty band and many people, with Timotheus for their leader.
Ekegusii: Erio akaamboka kobachiera Abaamoni. Akanyora abarwani esegi abaange bare n’echinguru, barenge koragwa na Timotheo.

English: He fought many battles with them, and they were defeated before his face. He struck them,
Ekegusii: Yuda akabarwania abarwani abwo b’esegi boire; goika akababua chinguru.

English: and took possession of Jazer and its villages, and returned again into Judea.
Ekegusii: Akayoira omochie o Yezeri amo ne ebinyoro biaye erio akairana ase omochie o Yudea.

English: The Gentiles who were in Gilead gathered themselves together against the Israelites who were on their borders, to destroy them. They fled to the stronghold of Dathema,
Ekegusii: Abanto be ebisaku bagasangererekana agwo Gileadi erio babagwere na kobasiria Abaisraeli abwo bamenyete sobo. Korende Abaisraeli bagatama goika ebiita bia Dathema,

English: and sent letters to Judas and his kindred, saying, “The Gentiles who are around us are gathered together against us to destroy us.
Ekegusii: na komoriikera Yuda amo na abamwabo riruube erio riarenge goteeba: Abanto bebeisaku abwo tobebekaine nabarabwo basangererekanire erio batosirie.

English: They are preparing to come and get possession of the stronghold where we fled for refuge, and Timotheus is the leader of their army.
Ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barobeirie gocha ase twebisete na Timotheo nere okobaraa abarwani esegi baabo.

English: Now therefore come and deliver us from their hand, for many of us have fallen.
Ekegusii: Bono kora bwango ochiche ototoorie ekiagera abanto baito abaange baitirwe.

English: All our kindred who were in the land of Tubias have been put to death. They have carried their wives, their children, and their stuff into captivity. They destroyed about a thousand men there.”
Ekegusii: Abanto baminto bonsi abwo barenge ase ense ya Tobu baitirwe; ababisa bairire abakungu baabo, abana baabo ne chinibo chiabo na goita abanto goika ekerengo kia 1,000.

English: While the letters were still being read, behold, other messengers came from Galilee with their clothes torn, bringing a similar report,
Ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete gosoma riruube erio, abatomwa bande, abwo batandorete chiayanga chiabo ase obororo bakarenta amang’ana agwekaine ayio korwa Galili.

English: saying, “People of Ptolemais, of Tyre, of Sidon, and all Galilee of the Gentiles have gathered together to destroy us.”
Ekegusii: Bagateeba: “Abarwani esegi korwa Tolemai, Turo, Sidoni na orogongo rwonsi rwa Galili nigo basangererekanete erio batosirie.”

English: Now when Judas and the people heard these words, a great congregation assembled together to determine what they should do for their kindred who were in distress and under attack.
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuda amo na abanto baye baigwete amang’ana ayio onsi, bakarangeria omosangererekano omonene erio baetie enchera bagochia kobakoonya abanto bamwabo abwo bachaandegete ase okoumokerwa na ababisa.

English: Judas said to Simon his brother, “Choose men and go deliver your kindred who are in Galilee, but Jonathan my brother and I will go into the land of Gilead.”
Ekegusii: Yuda akamoteebia Simioni momura omwabo: “chora abanto bake korwa ase ore ogeende obatoorie Abayahudi baminto bare Galili, erio inche amo n’oyominto Yoronathani togende Gileadi.”

English: He left Joseph the son of Zacharias, and Azarias, as leaders of the people, with the remnant of the army, in Judea, to guard it.
Ekegusii: Yuda akabitiga ebiombe binde bia abarwani esegi inse yoborai bwa Yosefu omwana o Zakaria na Asaria omorai bwa abanto barende Yudea.

English: He commanded them, saying, “Take charge of this people, and fight no battle with the Gentiles until we return.”
Ekegusii: Ere akabateebia abwo babere: “Barigererie abanto aba korende inwe timwesoyia ase okorwana esegi na abanto b’ebisaku binde goika intwe twairanire.”

English: Then three thousand men were assigned to go into Galilee with Simon, but eight thousand men were assigned to Judas to go into the land of Gilead.
Ekegusii: Simioni akabogoria abanto 3,000 na kogenda nabarabwo goika Galili, nere Yuda akageenda na abanto 8,000 ase ensemo yaye.

English: Simon went into Galilee and fought many battles with the Gentiles, and the Gentiles were defeated before him.
Ekegusii: Ekero Simioni aigete Galili, akarwana chiseegi na chinyinge na abanto b’ebisaku goika ere akababua

English: He pursued them to the gate of Ptolemais. About three thousand men of the Gentiles fell, and he took their spoils.
Ekegusii: na kobatunyana goika omochie o Tolemai. Akabaita abanto goika omobaro o 3,000 boigo agasakora chinibo chiabo.

English: They took to them those who were in Galilee and in Arbatta, with their wives, their children, and all that they had, and brought them into Judea with great gladness.
Ekegusii: Erio akababogoria Abayahudi abwo barenge Galili na Aribata amo na abakungu baabo, abana ne chinibo chiabo chionsi, akairana amo nabwo goika Yudea ase ogochenga okonene.

English: Judas Maccabaeus and his brother Jonathan passed over the Jordan, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness.
Ekegusii: Ase ebiro ebio Yuda Makabi na Yonathani momura omwabo konye barabwo batambokire orooche rwa Yorodani na goeta erooro ase rituko ria gatato.

English: They met with the Nabathaeans, and these met them in a peaceful manner and told them all things that had happened to their kindred in the land of Gilead,
Ekegusii: Bakaumerana na abande ba abamenyi ba Ababetea abwo babaariganetie ase omorembe na boigo kobamanyia aria abanyoorete Abayahudi bamwabo agwo Gileadi.

English: and how many of them were shut up in Bosora, Bosor, Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim—all these cities are strong and large—
Ekegusii: Ababetea abwo bakabamanyia buna Abayahudi abange nigo barenge abasibwa ase emechie egiteire ya Bozira, Bosori, Alema, Chafuso, Makedi na Karinaimu; emechie emenene n’emeke;

English: and how they were shut up in the rest of the cities of the land of Gilead, and that tomorrow they planned to encamp against the strongholds, and to take them, and to destroy all these men in one day.
Ekegusii: abande nigo basibire ase emechie emeke emeke ya Gileadi. Boigo bakabateebia buna ababisa beariganetie gochigwera chimbago erio bababwate na kobasiria Abayahudi bonsi ase rituko erimo.

English: Judas and his army turned suddenly by the way of the wilderness to Bosora; and he took the city, and killed all the males with the edge of the sword, took all their spoils, and burned the city with fire.
Ekegusii: Kegima Yuda na abarwani baye b’esegi bagekiora na goeta ase echera ye erooro. Bakayogwera na koyoira omochie o Bozira na kobaita abanto bonsi ase omochie oyio bakayosakora na koyosamba omochie oyio.

English: He left there at night, and went until he came to the stronghold.
Ekegusii: Erio bagasooka na gotaara ase obotuko obwo obogima goika bagasoa ase chimbebe chia omochie o Dathema.

English: When the morning came, they lifted up their eyes and saw many people who couldn’t be counted, bearing ladders and engines of war, to take the stronghold; and they were fighting against them.
Ekegusii: Mambia chuni, Yuda amo na abanto baye bakarora abarwani esegi abange batanyaare kobareka babogoretie chingazi na ebirwanero, baganetie koira ense na kobagwera Abayahudi.

English: Judas saw that the battle had begun, and that the cry of the city went up to heaven, with trumpets and a great sound,
Ekegusii: Ekero Yuda aigwete eriogi na okobuga gwechitarumbeta korwa ime yomochie, akamanya buna esegi yachaakire.

English: and he said to the men of his army, “Fight today for your kindred!”
Ekegusii: Erio akabateebia abanto baye: “Tiga torwane esegi reero ase engencho ya Abayahudi baminto!”

English: Then he went out behind them in three companies. They sounded with their trumpets and cried out in prayer.
Ekegusii: Yuda akaroberia abanto ase ebiombe bitato, bageende motwe ensemo ya magega ya ababisa baabo; bakabugia egetuureri na gosaba ase eriogi rinene.

English: And the army of Timotheus perceived that it was Maccabaeus, and they fled from before him. He struck them with a great slaughter. About eight thousand men of them fell on that day.
Ekegusii: Abarwani esegi barenge koragwa na Timotheo bakamanya buna oyio Makabi okobaachera, erio bakaminyoka bagatama bamotang’anere motwe. Yuda akabaita ogoita okonene goika ekerengo kia abanto 8,000 ase rituko erio.

English: He turned away to Mizpeh and fought against it, took it, killed all its males, took its spoils, and burned it with fire.
Ekegusii: Erio Yuda akayoonchokera omochie bwa Alema akayogwera na kobaita abanto baye bonsi, agasakora na koyosamba omochie oyio

English: From there he marched and took Casphor, Maked, Bosor, and the other cities of the land of Gilead.
Ekegusii: Korwa agwo agasuka motwe na akayeira emechie ya Chasifo, Makedi, Bosori na eyende ya Gileadi.

English: Now after these things, Timotheus gathered another army and encamped near Raphon beyond the brook.
Ekegusii: Magega yayio, Timotheo agasaangereria abarwani esegi bande, akabeeka ekambi ase chinsinyo chia Rafoni ase engegu ya kabere y’orooche.

English: Judas sent men to spy on the army; and they brought him word, saying, “All the Gentiles who are around us are gathered together to them, an exceedingly great army.
Ekegusii: Naende Yuda agatoma abanto bande kogenda koroota ekambi eyio ya ababisa. Barabwo bakamoiraneria amang’ana buna abanto bebeisaku binde babwatanire na Timotheo na koroisia ekeombe kia abarwani esegi abange mono.
